blocks.text: Truth tables logic mein statements ki truth values (sach ya jhoot) dikhane ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh samjhate hain ke logical expressions kaise kaam karte hain. Truth table truth values ke tamam mumkin combinations (jor) likhta hai aur har combination ka aakhri nateeja dikhata hai. Propositional logic mein truth tables aham hain aur computer science aur maths mein aam istemal hote hain. Yeh logical expressions ki durusti check karne mein madad dete hain aur logical soch ko saaf aur aasan banate hain (Figure 2.5 dekhein).

blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Logical expressions ka truth table

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko line ba line parhein. A AND B sirf pehli line mein True hai, jahan A aur B dono True hain. A OR B sirf aakhri line mein False hai, jahan dono False hain. NOT A hamesha A ka ulat hai.

Truth tables ka asal maqsad yeh dikhana hai ke koi logical expression kaise behave karta hai (kab kya nateeja deta hai). In se pata chalta hai ke statement kab sach hai aur kab jhoot. Truth table tamam mumkin input values likhta hai, is liye reasoning mein uljhan door hoti hai. Truth tables se hum mushkil expressions aasani se check kar sakte hain aur mukhtalif statements ka muqabla (compare) kar sakte hain. Yeh faisla karne mein kaam aate hain aur logic aur computer science ke aham auzaar (tools) hain.
Logical expressions ke truth tables banana

Truth table banane ka pehla step propositions pehchanna hai (maslan A aur B). Har proposition ko true ya false value di jati hai. Truth values ke tamam mumkin combinations likhe jate hain. Phir logical connectives (AND, OR, NOT) qadam ba qadam lagaye jate hain, aur har row (line) ka aakhri nateeja likha jata hai. Is tarah expression saaf samajh aata hai. Truth table saaf suthra aur tarteeb wala hona chahiye; aisa table parhna aur istemal karna aasan hota hai.

Har proposition, jaise P ya Q, ki value True (T) ya False (F) ho sakti hai. Truth table tamam mumkin combinations likhta hai: n propositions ke liye 2ⁿ rows. Maslan 2 propositions ke liye 2² = 4 rows aur 3 ke liye 2³ = 8 rows. Compound proposition ki truth value us ke hisson (components) ki values se tay hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: (A AND B) OR (NOT A) ka truth table likhein. Is ke liye kitni rows chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Do propositions hain, is liye 2² = 4 rows. A=T, B=T: T OR F = T. A=T, B=F: F OR F = F. A=F, B=T: F OR T = T. A=F, B=F: F OR T = T. Yeh expression sirf tab jhoot hai jab A sach aur B jhoot ho.

items: Truth table har input combination aur us ka nateeja likhta hai.
Banane ka tareeqa: propositions pehchano, saare combinations likho, connectives lagao, har row ka nateeja likho.
